analysis.title: The Big Russell Short
key_insights: Russell 2000 broke below its longer-term trend line and is trading well below its 200-day moving average. The last time it undershot the 200-day, buyers stepped in and triggered a sharp reversal.
Russell is trading at deeply oversold levels. The note says oversold alone is not a strategy, but several factors could set up a short-term reversal.
Russell has tracked the US 10-year yield (inverted) closely for weeks, and the gap between the two is now widening, which the note flags as interesting.
CDX 5-year high-yield spreads widened to six-month highs, with CoreWeave-related contagion cited as a major catalyst. This added pressure to Russell 2000.
Goldman's High Yield Debt Sensitive basket fell 4.9% while Russell 2000 fell 1.9%. Russell has significant exposure to sub-investment-grade companies.

Since July, CFTC data shows a positive short-term correlation between changes in hedge fund Russell 2000 short positioning and CDX high-yield spreads. Hedge funds added Russell shorts as credit deteriorated.
Hedge fund short positioning in Russell is now very large, which raises the potential for a sharp short-covering rally.
CTAs have aggressively sold Russell 2000 exposure and are at their shortest since 2023, leaving room for systematic buying if the index starts to rise.
The note says two crowded trades (AI and bonds) blew up recently and asks whether a Russell squeeze could be the next pain trade.
